name: Free film pack
note: Public-domain and NASA film clips for Morph: Your clips, curated 1 Nov 2026: colour and action first, a few quiet colour clips for the calm passages and the strongest black-and-white for the drops. Nothing here is shipped: Setup & models pulls each window with ffmpeg (a byte-range read of the source, a few MB a clip) into work/ui/film_pack/, and writes CREDITS.md beside the clips. A source marked whole is downloaded in full first. Times are seconds in the source file; file names the derivative taken (the smallest with 480 lines or more) and bytes its size. A clip's crop (w:h:x:y) cuts off the bars of its window. colour is false for black-and-white film (the taste file's measure), motion is the clip's frame-to-frame change over 25 (clip_cut.MOTION_FULL), living says people or animals are in it (the kaleido steps aside), mood is the passage it suits (calm, build or drop). The clips are in the order a clips cut draws on them.
